Privacy

Your information.

Last updated: 18 September 2026

Inquiries

dot.wave uses the name, organization, email, market, project description and optional support and timeline details you provide to review and respond to your inquiry. Sending a form does not create a client relationship or subscribe you to marketing.

Handling and service providers

Inquiries are delivered to dotwave.creative@gmail.com. Website hosting, email delivery and mailbox providers process information needed to provide those services, which may involve processing outside your country. Access is limited to people who need the information to handle the inquiry. We do not sell inquiry information.

Retention and requests

We retain correspondence as needed to respond, follow up and maintain relevant business records. You can ask about access, correction or deletion by emailing us. Some records may need to be retained to meet contractual or legal obligations.

Website measurement

We use Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights to understand page usage and performance. When event measurement is enabled, we measure actions such as opening work, language switching, profile downloads and inquiry completion. Form contents and email addresses are never included in analytics events.
